audience: teachers and organizers who run classes, workshops and camps with Corsizio

useCases.title: See upcoming classes and how full they are
useCases.text: The AI lists events by date range, status, category or location and reads registration counts for one event. You see which classes are almost full.

useCases.title: List everyone registered for an event
useCases.text: The AI gets one event together with its attendees, with name, email, phone, status and registration answers. You get a roster for the day.

useCases.title: Find attendees who still owe a payment
useCases.text: The AI lists registrations filtered by status, such as owing but not canceled, across the account or for one event.

useCases.title: Check the payment details of one registration
useCases.text: The AI reads one registration in full with its payment: amount, fees, taxes, refunds and transactions.

useCases.title: Read your account's locations, categories and levels
useCases.text: The AI reads the account's time zone, currency and its configured locations, categories, age groups, levels and price ranges, to use as filters.
